notes: Portrait sheet (SPECIAL USE DISTRICTS, SHEET 1SU, June 1990). A single heavy frame rule (~11 px) on the left, top and right; the outline sits ~1.5 px onto paper inside each rule's inner edge (README rule 1). The page is turned: the left rule runs from x ~81 at the top to ~50 at the bottom, the top rule from y ~637 at the left to ~661 at the right, the right rule from x ~3218 to ~3185. Bottom: just above the top edge of the thick bar (~25 px) that rules off the legend strip (SPECIAL USE DISTRICTS, key A-J, code note, SHEET 1SU) and the title strip below it, both full width inside the frame (rule 3), y ~4204 at the left, ~4217 at the right. Sides measured row by row / column by column, windowed median, a vertex every ~200 px; corners where the sides' end fits meet; plain square corners, no arcs. On this sheet the north arrow is NOT in the legend strip: it floats on the map area at the lower right (a triangle with NORTH lettered across its base, ink x 2904-3031, y 3865-4005) and is the one remove polygon (rule 4), 6 points ~5 px outside its ink, on paper all round. The scale bar under it (from y ~4030) and its '0 FEET 800' stay inside (rule 4: scale bars are map); the polygon's bottom edge (y 4010) runs through the blank paper between NORTH and the bar. SAN FRANCISCO BAY, the district letters and the pier lines are map. Ink under the outline: 6.0 in all; 5.0 where the dashed pier head line at x ~2725 runs down into the bottom bar (map ink truly touching the rule; the outline keeps to the bar's edge there), and 1.0 from a one-pixel scan speck beside the left rule at (64, ~2692).
